name: protocol_golden_m1
description: The GDScript codec decodes every message of the M1 golden transcripts (recorded from the Python server) into the listed values, and encodes each back to the same bytes.

steps.msg: all 381 records decode and re-encode byte for byte
the transcripts speak this game's protocol version
every message of protocol.json is covered
turns and every PARTY op are in
a cut-off message is refused, not read past its end
a message with bytes left over is refused
a value that does not fit its field is not sent
